clips.title: The story
paras: Southshore's Chef Jessen wants Soothing Turtle Bisque back on his tavern menu. Unrest has cut off his supply of snapjaw turtle meat, so he asks cooks to brave the northern waters near Dalaran and Lake Lordamere.

Southshore is one of the Alliance's last intact coastal towns in Lordaeron, holding to civilian life amid growing strife. Chef Jessen says his cooking rivals any tavern north of Stormwind. Patrons supposedly travel from Darkshire in Duskwood to taste his Soothing Turtle Bisque. The rich soup depends on fresh meat from snapjaw turtles native to the rivers and lakes of the northern mountains.

In calmer years, Jessen gathered turtle meat himself, traveling past Dalaran to Lordamere Lake's eastern shore. Rising tensions, hostile wildlife, the Syndicate, and Forsaken incursions have made the lands beyond town deadly for ordinary townsfolk. To keep the bisque on his menu, Jessen depends on armed travelers willing to gather meat from snapjaws along the riverbanks and northern shores.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If there's one thing you'll learn about Southshore it's that we have some of the best cuisine north of Stormwind!

Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks to travel from as far as Darkshire just to enjoy a bowl. Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately. I used to head up past Dalaran to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt Snapjaws but it's just too dangerous now. If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the Snapjaws up north and Soothing Spices, I'll whip some up!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Any luck finding the ingredients? I'll tell you, this territory isn't the peaceful place it once was. Ah, if only this unrest never occurred...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Everyone will be so pleased: Chef Jessen's Soothing Turtle Bisque is served once again!
